paper_metadata.title: Molecular Dynamics Simulation of the Evolution of Interfacial Dislocation Network and Stress Distribution of a Ni-Based Single-Crystal Superalloy

evidence.section: Abstract
evidence.quote: The evolution of misfit dislocation network at c/c0 phase interfaces and the stress distribution characteristics of Ni-based single-crystal superalloys under different temperatures of 0, 100 and 300 K are studied by molecular dynamics (MD) simulation.

evidence.quote: MD simulations were performed for the idealized Ni-based superalloy composed of Ni3Al cuboidal precipitates (L12 c0 phase) and the pure Ni matrix (fcc c phase).

evidence.section: 3.2 Evolution of Dislocation Network and Stress Field at 300 K
evidence.quote: Once the dislocation network is damaged at the c/c0 interfaces, the dislocation network lose the co-ordinating role of maintaining the dynamic equilibrium; the slip dislocations in the c matrix may cut into the c0 phase from the interfaces where dislocation network is damaged.

mechanisms.name: misfit stress relaxation by interfacial dislocation network

evidence.section: 3.2 Evolution of Dislocation Network and Stress Field at 300 K
